summary: Forensic playback export, chain-of-custody manifest and HSM key-rotation attestation for eDiscovery
description:
Issue summary: First Meridian Bank legal team requests a timebounded, tamper-evident forensic export and playback package to satisfy an eDiscovery subpoena covering 2026-01-15 to 2026-01-22. They require chain-of-custody proof, HSM key-rotation attestations for the KMS keys used to sign manifests, and a sampling of raw events mapped back to customer user identifiers.

Impact: High — the export is required by the customer's legal hold with a court deadline. Customer cannot proceed without evidence of immutability and key custody.

Environment: Production (us-east tenant scoped).

Requested deliverables: 1) A resumeable forensic export (S3 presigned package) of ordered audit events for the date range, including raw event JSON and the internal redaction/pseudonymization map. 2) A signed chain-of-custody manifest (RFC-style) with per-file SHA256 checksums and an ed25519 signature. 3) HSM-backed KMS key-rotation audit (rotation events, attestations, and certs) that show key versions active during the range. 4) A small sample (100 events) translated to customer identity mapping for validation, with redaction applied per agreed policy. 5) A playback harness (script + instructions) and a short runbook for verifying checksums and signatures.

Steps taken: Customer submitted signed PO and legal letter on 2026-02-17. Support confirmed receipt 2026-02-18 and asked for tenant GUID and exact time windows. SRE asked for internal retention exceptions and whether there were archival snapshots.

Logs/Context: Log retention TTL for tenant is 365 days. No prior legal holds on the date range. Potential large export size (~120GB) estimated by retention sizing tool.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Customer (legal): Please confirm you can produce a tamper-evident export and include proof of key custody. Court date: 2026-03-10.
2026-02-18 - Support (Aisha): Acknowledged. Please upload signed PO and tenant GUID; we will triage and request SRE assistance. Target first response within 24 hours.

2026-02-19 - SRE (Marco): Checked retention and available snapshot. There is a cold snapshot for 2026-01-20 that covers the window. Potential blocker: manifest signing currently uses ephemeral key; will require HSM attestation export. Opening infra task.

2026-02-20 - Support (Aisha): Customer provided tenant GUID and a redaction policy matrix. Coordinating with Legal to validate acceptable pseudonymization output. Notifying customer of estimated timeline (5 business days for a full package).
2026-02-22 - Infra (Lena): Created PR to add manifest HSM signing export endpoint: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821. Needs security review before running for customer exports.

2026-02-24 - Support (Marco): HSM attestation export produced and verified by security. Prepared S3 bundle with manifest and checksums; presigned URL sent to customer for one-time download. Customer confirmed receipt and validated sample mappings.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Exportable artifacts exist in cold snapshots; chain-of-custody can be produced by combining snapshot index, object checksums, and the HSM signing attestations.
Found snapshot: s3://redwood-archival/us-east/tenant-12345/snap-2026-01-20 containing event objects and index. Verified object counts against billing event counts for that day.

Security check: HSM logs (KMS) show a rotation event on 2025-12-03. Key version 3 was active during the requested date range. Obtained cert chain and audit logs from HSM provider; redacted sensitive internals. See slack thread #support-legal-612984.
Refer: Confluence forensics playbook (https://confluence.internal.redwood/display/OPS/Forensic+Playback+Runbook) and infra PR 4821 for the signing endpoint.
Risk: Export contains tenant-scoped PII; ensure pseudonymization map included and delivery channel is encrypted, presigned, single-use.
resolution: 2026-02-25 - Resolved. Delivered a presigned S3 bundle containing: ordered event files for 2026-01-15..2026-01-22, per-file SHA256 checksums, ed25519-signed manifest, HSM key-rotation attestation bundle (certs and rotation log), and a 100-event sample mapped to customer identities per their mapping table. Provided playback script and verification runbook. Security reviewed and signed off; export delivered under an approved legal PO and an encrypted transfer window. Customer confirmed receipt and validated sample. Follow-up: post-delivery security review scheduled 2026-03-02 to extract generic runbook improvements. Ticket closed after confirmation.
follow_up_items: Runbook update: include HSM-attestation step and presigned-one-time-url checklist
Make HSM signing export endpoint GA after security review
Create template legal export SLA and pricing for future enterprise requests
